prayers.stationsOpeningPrayer: My Lord Jesus Christ, You made this journey to die for me with unspeakable love, and I have so many times unworthily abandoned You. But now I love You with all my heart, and, because I love You, I am sincerely sorry for ever having offended You. Pardon me, my God, for the sake of the merits of Your bitter Passion, and grant me the grace to accompany You in this journey with true contrition for my sins, that I may attain to a happy eternity. Amen.
prayers.stationsClosingPrayer: Lord Jesus Christ, we thank You for the Passion by which You have redeemed us. Grant that, having meditated on Your sufferings on earth, we may deserve to enjoy their fruit in heaven, where You live and reign forever and ever. Amen.
prayers.station01Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Pilate finds no fault in Jesus, yet washes his hands and delivers Him to be crucified, condemning the innocent to satisfy the crowd.
prayers.station02Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Jesus willingly takes up the heavy wood of the cross, embracing the instrument of His death out of love for us.
prayers.station03Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Weakened by the scourging and the weight of the cross, Jesus falls to the ground beneath its burden.
prayers.station04Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Along the road to Calvary, Jesus meets His Mother, and their eyes meet in a sorrow too deep for words.
prayers.station05Title: Simon of Cyrene Helps Jesus Carry the Cross
prayers.station05Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

The soldiers compel Simon of Cyrene, a passerby, to help Jesus carry the cross the rest of the way.
prayers.station06Title: Veronica Wipes the Face of Jesus
prayers.station06Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

A woman named Veronica steps forward from the crowd to wipe the face of Jesus, and His image remains upon her veil.
prayers.station07Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Jesus falls a second time beneath the cross, His strength nearly spent.
prayers.station08Title: Jesus Meets the Women of Jerusalem
prayers.station08Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Jesus turns to the women of Jerusalem who weep for Him, and tells them to weep instead for themselves and their children.
prayers.station09Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Jesus falls a third time, so close now to Calvary, and rises once more to finish the journey.
prayers.station10Title: Jesus is Stripped of His Garments
prayers.station10Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

At Calvary, the soldiers strip Jesus of His garments, adding humiliation to His suffering.
prayers.station11Title: Jesus is Nailed to the Cross
prayers.station11Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Jesus is stretched upon the cross and nailed to it by His hands and feet.
prayers.station12Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Jesus dies on the cross, having given His life for the salvation of the world.
prayers.station13Title: Jesus is Taken Down from the Cross
prayers.station13Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus take the body of Jesus down from the cross and place it in the arms of His Mother.
prayers.station14Title: Jesus is Laid in the Tomb
prayers.station14Body:
We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You.
**Because by Your holy Cross You have redeemed the world.**

The body of Jesus is laid in a new tomb, and a great stone is rolled before the entrance.
